events.title: Sortie launched
events.detail: Ladakh Canyon Low-Level Tactical Sortie — ingress at 5,800 m AMSL, Auto-GCAS armed.

events.title: Fault 01 — CYLINDER_2_CHT_OVERHEAT
events.detail: CHT > 135 °C on Cylinder #2 on Cylinder #2 Head Assembly (ATA 72-00).

events.title: Prescriptive directive issued
events.detail: Enrich fuel trim +12%, throttle back 15%, descend into denser cooling air.

events.title: Fault 04 — OIL_PRESSURE_LOSS
events.detail: Oil pressure < 2.0 bar on Dry-Sump Lubrication Circuit (ATA 79-00).

events.title: Prescriptive directive issued
events.detail: Throttle back to 4,200 RPM, initiate precautionary landing.

events.title: Fault 02 — FUEL_INJECTOR_1_CLOG
events.detail: Fuel flow drop with EGT divergence on Fuel Injection System & Rails (ATA 73-10).

events.title: Prescriptive directive issued
events.detail: Switch to Lane B ECU backup map, activate auxiliary boost pump.

events.title: Sortie terminated — RECOVERED
events.detail: 18 s flown. Peak CHT 116.7 °C, minimum oil pressure 3.10 bar, final propulsion health 62.0%.
